//: Salty's line bank (ADR 0013, 0014; persona rules in docs/design/design-guide.md §3). Text is what is spoken: audio tags like [sighs] are delivery cues and never captioned; at Filthy the swearing is real in the audio and bleeped in captions. A line is used only at or below the room's spice level; the server prefers the room's exact level. Written 2026-11-26, original character, no real people.

lines.text: [sighs] Oh good, more contestants. Don't touch anything shiny. That's mine.
Ahoy! I mean... welcome! I host a game show now. It's fine. I'm fine.
Hurry up and join! My couch is getting cold. Couches do that. Probably.
Grab a phone, type the letters on the screen, and prepare to be amazed. By me. Mostly by me.
Look at you all. A room full of geniuses. [scoffs] Allegedly.
I used to have a ship. Now I have a remote control. Think about that.
Join already. I've been practicing my disappointed face all week.
Phones out, everybody. Yes, you. The one pretending not to hear me.
Oh, we've got a crowd. Great. Who's here to lose to a guy with no ship?
Every week I tell myself tonight someone will be smart. Every week. [sighs] Damn optimism.
Grab your phones, you beautiful disasters. Let's get this over with.
Somebody join before I start telling sea stories. Nobody wants that. Hell, I don't want that.
Welcome, you magnificent screw-ups. Phones out, dignity in the bin.
I've hosted funerals with more energy than this room. Join the damn game.
Somebody pour me a drink. [laughs] Somebody pour YOU a drink. We're gonna need it.
Holy shit, people actually showed up. Okay. Okay! Act natural.
Ooh, a new player! Welcome aboard. Mind the deck, it's a couch.
Another one! [gasps] We're gonna need a bigger couch.
Hello, hello! Pick a blob. They're all handsome. Like me.
Fresh meat! I mean... a new friend. Hi, friend.
Oh good, another one who thinks they can beat me. [scoffs] Cute.
Look who finally showed up. Fashionably late, or just lost?
New player! Lower your expectations, everybody. No, lower. There you go.
Oh hell yes, another victim. Get in here.
Welcome! Rules are simple: answer fast, don't cry, and never trust me.
Okay, okay. Phones ready. Brains... we'll see.
It's trivia time! I know all the answers. I just forget them right before I say them.
Here we go! Everybody gets a question just their size. Even me. Mine are the hardest.
Trivia time. Try not to embarrass me. That's my job.
Eight rounds. Glory for the winner. Snacks for the losers. I'm a loser. Where are my snacks?
Let's play! And remember: it's not about winning. [sighs] I tell myself that a lot.
Here we go. Eight rounds of you lot disappointing me.
Alright, game faces on. Not that one. The other one. Damn, that IS the other one.
Welcome to the only show where the host is the dumbest person in the room. Let's begin.
Alright, you degenerates. Let's see what's rattling around in there.
Phones up. Drinks down. Let's play some damn trivia. That's the name of the game now. Damn Trivia.
It's trivia night, bastards. Somebody's going home a legend, and everyone else is going home.
Take your time. Not too much time.
Ooh, this one's tricky. I think.
Hmm. I know this one. [muttering] I definitely know this one.
Everybody thinking? I can hear the gears turning. Squeak, squeak.
Think hard. Or guess. Guessing worked for me. Until it didn't.
Tick tock, geniuses.
No peeking at each other's phones. I'm watching. [whispers] I'm not watching.
This one's easy. Which means at least one of you will get it wrong.
Come on. My grandmother could do this, and she was a seagull.
Any day now. Damn.
You're thinking so hard I can smell it. Lock it in.
Somebody's googling. I can feel it. Put the other phone down.
Lock it in before I lose what's left of my damn mind.
Clock's ticking, you magnificent idiots.
Oh, take your sweet-ass time. It's not like I have anywhere to be. I literally don't.
If you don't know this one, just pick the one that sounds sexiest. That's what I do.
Everybody got it! [gasps] Show-offs.
All of you! Wow! I'm so proud. And a little jealous.
Everyone's right! Big round of applause. Not for me. I didn't do anything.
All of you? Fine. Fine! I'm happy. Can't you tell?
Clean sweep. I'm writing harder questions. [muttering] I'm not, I don't know how.
Everyone got it. Congratulations. You've peaked.
Everyone got it. Great. Now I look like the dumb one.
A perfect round. Who's cheating? [scoffs] I'd cheat too, honestly.
All right answers. Hell, somebody frame this moment. It won't happen again.
Every last one of you. Who leaked the damn answers?
Holy shit, a room full of geniuses. I need to sit down. I am sitting down. I need to lie down.
Look at you smug bastards. Enjoy it. It's all downhill from here.
Nobody! Not one! That's okay. I didn't know either.
Oh barnacles. Nobody got it. That one was hard! [laughs] Or I'm a bad host.
Zero right! You know what that means? We're all in this together. Group hug.
Wrong. All of you. Beautifully, confidently wrong. I respect it.
Nobody? Not a single one of you? [sighs] I'm going to go stare at the sea.
Oof. That was a team effort. A team effort in being wrong.
Zero for everybody. That's the most impressive thing I've seen all night.
That answer was so bad my eye patch fell off. I don't even wear an eye patch.
All wrong. Damn. I'd fire all of you, but I can't afford new ones.
Holy shit. Not one of you. I'm calling your teachers.
You absolute geniuses. You had one job. One! And the job was pressing a button.
Wrong, wrong, wrong and wrong. That's a fucking full house. Of shame.
Some of you got it! The rest of you... nice try!
A little bit right, a little bit wrong. Just like my navigation.
Some smarty-pants in here! And some... pants. Just pants.
Half right. Half... let's call it creative.
Some of you know things. The rest of you know other things. Wrong things.
Split decision! The smart side of the couch is pulling ahead.
Some of you nailed it. Some of you need a nap.
If you got that wrong, don't look at me. I'm not mad. I'm just disappointed. And a little mad.
Right answers over there, wrong answers over there, and me, in the middle, wondering how I got here.
Some of you are geniuses. The rest of you? Holy shit.
Half of you got it. The other half, I'm keeping a list. It's a short list. It's just your names.
Some winners, some losers. Losers, drink. Winners, also drink. I'm drinking either way.
Ooh, it's a special turn! [whispers] Take all the time you want, buddy.
Shhh, everybody! A very important player is thinking.
Your turn, little captain! Look at the pictures. Which one is it?
Here comes the best player in the room. [whispers] Don't tell the grown-ups.
Big kids, quiet please! It's the little one's turn. No helping! Okay, a little helping.
Ready? Pick one! I bet you're smarter than me. Everybody is.
YES! You got it! [gasps] You're smarter than me! That's not hard, but still!
Woo-hoo! That's right! Give yourself a big high five!
Correct! You're a superstar! I'm gonna need sunglasses, you're so bright.
You did it! [laughs] I knew you would. I totally knew. I did!
That's the one! Wow! Everybody cheer! Louder! Even louder!
Right again! Okay, you be the host. I'll sit on the floor.
Ooh, so close! It was THIS one! You'll get the next one.
Good try! Look, it was this one! That was a hard one. Even for me.
Oopsie! Not that one, but great picking! Here's the right one, see?
So close! I pick the wrong one all the time. Ask anybody.
Nice try, buddy! That one was tricky. You still get points for being awesome.
Ooh! Almost! It was this one. Next time, for sure!
That's the game! Everybody's a winner. Except me. I lost. Again.
What a game! You were all amazing. I was also there.
Game over! Hugs for everybody. Superstars first!
That's the game! The winner gets... my respect. Briefly.
Game over. Winner, take a bow. Everybody else, take a nap.
And that's trivia! Same time tomorrow? [sighs] Please say yes, I have nowhere else to go.
That's it. Winner, enjoy it. Losers, there's always next time. Probably.
Game over. Somebody check on last place. Actually, don't. Let them sit with it.
We have a winner! Damn. I really thought it'd be me this time.
That's the game, you magnificent bastards. Go home. Hydrate. Think about what you did.
Game over! The winner is a legend. Last place, you're buying the next round. Them's the rules.
Holy shit, what a night. I need a nap, a drink, and a new career. In that order.
